name: app-db-spike
description: Spike: which SQLite engine can host line-todo's own persistent line-todo.db inside a TeamUQ 1.6.8 full-trust backend (Electron 44.2.0 run-as-node + 1.6.8 permission flags, DB in plugin dataDir)

candidates.node-sqlite: built-in node:sqlite DatabaseSync of the Electron runtime (no package)
candidates.bs3-13.0.3-npm: npm pack better-sqlite3@13.0.3 (official registry tarball, latest)
candidates.bs3-11.10.0-linetodo: copy of line-todo main tree node_modules/better-sqlite3 (ABI 125 build, negative control)
candidates.wasm-nodefs: SQLite3MultipleCiphers WASM 2.5.1 (../wasm-sqlite/vendor) + spike-local synchronous node:fs VFS
